answer_to_section_9: The deployed flash-loan executor is INTENTIONALLY Uniswap-V3-only (Balancer V2 flash + UniV3 swaps). The safety gate (would_execute AND exec_capability != EXECUTABLE_UNIV3 -> non-executable) is correct and must be kept. Aerodrome adapters/settlement simulator exist for INTELLIGENCE + settlement simulation, not live execution. No Aerodrome/mixed route may be marked executable until a complete atomic executor path + full simulation tests exist.
